summary: Frontend-only test of new HeroCarousel + LiveScoresTicker on Sportsbook (desktop 1920 + mobile 390, signed out). Welcome slide (headline, Join now CTA, 0 live / 186 markets), 4 featured match slides (NFL NE@CHI, NBA BOS@DET, UFC Volkanovski vs Evloev w/ headshots + records 28-4-0/20-0-0, EPL NFO vs IPS with abbr fallback + Draw) all render from real event data. Auto-rotation (welcome->match after ~6.5s), hover pause (8s no change), prev/next (incl. wrap welcome->SOCCER), dots and active-dot progress bar all work. Countdown shows D/H/M or H/M/S. Odds are ordered away/draw/home to match the sides. Clicking a hero odd adds it to the bet slip (count 1, toast). Ticker scrolls (transform changes), pauses on hover (animationPlayState=paused), 48 items (24 doubled). Regression: boosts-strip, casino-strip, odds-grid (171 match cards) all present. No page errors. ONE real bug: a selected hero odds button becomes invisible.

ui_bugs.issue: After you click a hero odds button (selected state), its label and price can't be seen. The wrapper's arbitrary variant [&>button]:bg-black/50 overrides OddsButton's selected bg-emerald-500, while text-black still applies. Computed: bg rgba(0,0,0,0.5), color rgb(0,0,0), so black text sits on a dark background. Reproduced on desktop and mobile. Fix: use [&>button:not(.bg-emerald-500)]:bg-black/50 (or pass a variant/className prop to OddsButton so the selected style wins).

issues: The stats row wraps, so '186 markets' drops to its own line at about y=397 and almost touches the slide dots at y=403. Consider a smaller gap, hiding markets on xs, or extra bottom padding.
Prev/next arrows are hidden below sm and there is no swipe gesture, so the only way to change slides is the 32x4px dots. That is a very small tap target.
Odds buttons end about 8px above the dots, which is tight but acceptable.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the invisible selected state on hero odds buttons in HeroCarousel.jsx line ~90 ([&>button]:bg-black/50 overrides selected bg-emerald-500)
Minor: Mobile welcome slide stats row wraps and crowds the dots
Minor: Add swipe support or larger dot tap targets on mobile
Minor: Hero odds buttons reuse the same data-testid as the event-list OddsButton (odds-button-{id}-moneyline-{side}), so there are 2 elements per id. Consider a hero- prefix for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroCarousel: Tailwind arbitrary child variant styling of a shared component (OddsButton) breaks its state classes. Prefer a prop.
Countdown runs a 1s interval per mounted slide. Fine, since only one is mounted at a time.
LiveScoresTicker: a time string from toTimeString() is in local time, which is fine. Animation duration is items*4s (about 96s for 24 items), so the scroll is slow but readable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero testids: hero-carousel, hero-slide-welcome, hero-slide-match-{event_id}, hero-dot-{welcome|NFL|NBA|UFC|SOCCER}, hero-carousel-prev/next (hidden on mobile), hero-countdown, hero-odds, hero-cta-signup, live-scores-ticker (.ticker-track). At test time there were 0 live events, so the LIVE badge and hero-live-score paths were NOT exercised. Retest them when games are live. Verify that the selected hero odds button is visible after the fix.
